items.quote: Depending on your development needs, you can use a generated API key or start the OAuth process with Squarespace to become a registered OAuth client.
items.why: Quote states both API key and OAuth methods are available.

items.quote: With Squarespace's Commerce Advanced plan, you can develop a custom application for a Squarespace merchant site.
items.why: Quote is about Commerce Advanced plan for custom apps; says nothing on admin review.

items.quote: We will review your registration and respond with `your_client_id` and `your_client_secret` as soon as possible.
items.why: Squarespace reviews the registration and returns client_id and client_secret; that is the approval gate.

items.quote: **Orders API:** Access order history for one-time purchases and subscription orders or import orders from third-party sales channels.
items.why: Only shows Orders API importing orders; no info on REST breadth or the other APIs.

items.quote: The Squarespace MCP server is a remote server. There's nothing to install.
items.why: Confirms a remote MCP server exists; URL and vendor-official status not stated.
